problem: Consider a linear transformation $T:{R}^{10}\to {R}^{10}.$ If $\text{rank}(T)=6$ then $\text{nullity}(T)=$
worked_solution:
According to the rank-nullity theorem, if $T:{R}^{n}\to {R}^{n},$ then

$$
\text{rank}(T)+\text{nullity}(T)=n.
$$

For the given transformation, we have $n=10.$ Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{rank}(T)+\text{nullity}(T) & =n \\ 6+\text{nullity}(T) & =10 \\ \text{nullity}(T) & =10-6 \\  & =4.\end{aligned}
$$
